title: メカトロニクス
subtitle: Mechatronics
educationalGoal: Understand mechatronics, a multidisciplinary field of mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, and computer engineering. Learn sensor technology, principles of motors, and electrical and electronic circuits for sensors and motors.
advice: This is a basic course in the design a simple mechatronic system. The following topics will be covered: 1. Prototyping a simple mechatronic system and understanding mechatronic systems deeply. 2. Understanding how to used use data sheets to select sensors, and understanding the circuits that connect sensors and microcomputers. 3. Understanding the characteristics of DC motors, and understanding how to use data sheets to select appropriate motors for a mechatronic system. 4. Making a simple mechatronic system by integrating sensors, motors, microcomputers, and other devices.
books: Textbooks: handout Reference books: eBook(Kanazawa Institute of Technology) Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of electrical and electronic circuits, control engineering, and computer engineering.

activityGoals.body: Understand the characteristics of sensors and select sensors appropriately.
Understand DC motors and select motors appropriately.
Create mechatronic systems that use sensor information for automatic control.
